summary: The prototype catalogue carries the 329 files its 170 pages reference into `.catalog-site` and gates every published page's asset refs against the built site, so a page with a 404 stylesheet fails the build instead of shipping.
reader_impact: A person opening any V2 prototype at alignsynch-mockups.vercel.app sees the page as it was drawn — stylesheet, logo, fonts and scripts — instead of bare text.
